items.summary: Turn the long-tail posture work into durable desktop/mobile visual proof across a project page, legal page, and journal page.
items.why: The new primitives only matter if they read well away from the polished wayfinding pages. Screenshot proof keeps the studio posture honest and gives later sessions a visual baseline instead of prose confidence.
items.recipe: Add a Playwright-backed visual proof capture script plus a nonblank manifest checker, then capture desktop/mobile screenshots for `projects/vorn/`, `/privacy/`, and `journal/community-enters-the-vault/`.

items.summary: Make the empty RUM loop explain itself instead of silently falling back to synthetic performance checks.
items.why: `data/rum-summary.json` currently has zero samples, but the build still passes because the perf gate has a designed fallback. A diagnostic artifact turns that from an ambiguous warning into a precise next action without committing raw visitor data.
items.recipe: Add `scripts/check-rum-export-path.mjs` to inspect summary/source availability, emit `.cache/rum-export-diagnostics.json`, and wire a nonblocking check into `build:check`.

items.summary: Clear stale runway truth so the next genius list promotes current S171 work instead of already-completed S168/S169 carries.
items.why: The task board still contains an old open legacy-intelligence item even though S169 completed and gated it. Leaving it open makes the deterministic genius list look less intelligent than the repo really is.
items.recipe: Mark the stale S168 legacy-intelligence carry as closed with S169 evidence, keep the current Now queue focused on S171 proof/data/membership decisions, and regenerate the genius list.
